latest_user_rules.precedence: v7 extends v6/v5/v4: explicit analytical sections and consistent spacing, selective bold/blue/red underline, specific remember/prepare messages; body 12pt, headings 14.5pt, title 24pt and governing 20pt retained

provenance_definitions.fact: PPTX XML, inherited styles, file hashes or original embedded asset
provenance_definitions.default: Recommended synthesis; not asserted identical across source slides

navy.evidence: all 19 decks, used layout layers; D01 layout2 shape240

color_policy.emphasis: red for meaning, not decoration; bold is the first emphasis
color_policy.chart_series: derive from actual categories; add justified series colors to the project lock

typography.missing_font_action: select installed fallback, record it in project spec, recheck line-wrap and fit; do not change system configuration
typography.size_application_policy: offer source-match px defaults for read-close reports; recommend larger sizes for projection; confirmed project px values always win and must not be recomputed

classic-grid.footer_exception: D13 has plain page number and slogan in place of left logo

solid-navy.image_policy: only user-supplied or authorized sourced/generated assets; no copied client illustration by default

slim-line.source_exception: D19 slide2 Contents uses broad grid frame; new decks default to one frame family

grid.evidence: D01 used body layout geometry; apply only in header/footer

assets.logo_policy: preserve original pixels, transparency and aspect ratio; choose contrast-appropriate supplied asset

visual_style_behavior: Use a Korean consulting report aesthetic with a classification main title / subtitle, a formal Korean governing sentence below it, nominal structured body, and one boxed formal final message on dense pages, aligned rectangular analytical frames and compact readable text. Separate structural header, client-logo reserve, evidence area and footer; the broad header ends in a diagonal logo reserve and carries a very low-opacity fine grid, while the selected slim variant uses a narrow underline. Compose actual tables, equal-axis comparisons, process stages, schedules and scope/role diagrams as editable evidence rather than decorative cards. Select one installed source font family for Korean, Latin and numbers and distinguish roles by weight and size. Use the locked palette for structural contrast, grouping and restrained semantic emphasis. Keep the evidence field flat, align column starts and rows, and split content before shrinking past legibility. Use only current-project evidence images and verified own-company assets; do not copy old client facts or marks. Omit the grid in the solid variant and keep it only in the underline in the slim variant.

design_character_notes.shape_and_decoration: Consulting report structure: rectangular evidence frames, narrow rules, data tables, aligned comparisons and semantic process connectors. Broad header has a diagonal white client-logo reserve; fine grid texture appears only in header/footer or slim underline. Rounded forms only where the selected source function calls for them.
design_character_notes.typography_character: Korean sans serif with bold numbered topic title, smaller inline subtopic, bold one-to-two-line lead and compact regular report text. One selected source family covers Korean, Latin and numbers. Readability and source evidence govern density; projection delivery splits dense content.
design_character_notes.color_behavior: Dark structural header/footer surround a white evidence field. Gray groups and differentiates steps and tables; red marks meaningful differences, requirements or risks sparingly. Client logo hues do not define the palette.
design_character_notes.spacing_and_density: Report-oriented moderate-to-high density on a consistent baseline. Align column starts and table rows; keep title/logo, lead, evidence and footer regions distinct. Split content before shrinking beyond legibility.
design_character_notes.texture_and_elevation: Flat evidence field and restrained low-opacity grid on structural bands. No decorative depth by default. A specific reference variant may omit the grid or use a slim underline.
design_character_notes.images_and_illustrations: Use relevant current-project evidence images and the verified company logo. Preserve editable data tables/charts. Source-specific facility illustrations are optional and require appropriate supplied or authorized assets, not invented placeholders.

validation.limitations: This profile gives repeatable guidance, not a guarantee of pixel-identical output. Every new deck needs its own spec, content QA and rendering checks.
